rows.description: [ICLR 2025] CatVTON is a simple and efficient virtual try-on diffusion model with 1) Lightweight Network (899.06M parameters totally), 2) Parameter-Efficient Training (49.57M parameters trainable) and 3) Simplified Inference (< 8G VRAM for 1024X768 resolution).
A curated list of awesome research papers, projects, code, dataset, workshops etc. related to virtual try-on.
Official implementation of Magic Clothing: Controllable Garment-Driven Image Synthesis

[AAAI 2025]👔IMAGDressing👔: Interactive Modular Apparel Generation for Virtual Dressing. It enables customizable human image generation with flexible garment, pose, and scene control, ensuring high fidelity and garment consistency for virtual dressing.
